# Portfolio upgrade report

Verified on 7 October 2026. Upgrade pass across 281 owned repositories. All projects received automated architecture/interview guide and source-link checks. 184 services received shared validation, approval, concurrency, container, and deployment-example upgrades. The six newest projects and AutoMLOps received targeted functional improvements.

## Delivered behavior

- Production job targets are normalized before refusal checks; repeated lab approval is idempotent.
- Ops state access is synchronized; audit retention is capped at 5,000 events.
- 184 container examples run without root and have health checks; Kubernetes examples include resource budgets and process controls.
- Container CI checks recover from a cold-start connection reset and exercise readiness/liveness.
- Weather analysis skips non-finite/boolean/out-of-range values and reports valid-row counts, variability, and city sample counts.
- SQL row analysis validates input and calculates exact decimal totals. SQL templates are discoverable and ambiguous questions are rejected.
- Ticket classification exposes keyword evidence and review flags. Retrieval exposes matched terms and query coverage. The development planner describes scoped files and acceptance checks.
- AutoMLOps has one typed prediction route, liveness/readiness separation, graceful missing-model handling, and deterministic synthetic training. A real trained demo artifact was exercised locally.
- Larger projects received typed route/configuration fixes, corrected packaging and test paths, lint repairs, a declared Terraform provider constraint, and immutable scanner action references.
- Source-function anchors were refreshed in 111 architecture/interview guide sets.

## Verification

3,279 local tests passed across the upgraded runtime and legacy project suites. The portfolio frontend passed lint and a production build using CI-only placeholder configuration. The Python GCP toolkit built its source distribution and wheel. All 281 maintained project guide checks passed. GitHub CI results are recorded with project commits in the JSON companion report.

## Deployment boundaries

The shared services remain lab prototypes: tenant selection is not authenticated identity, state is process-local, and job approval does not execute production work. AutoMLOps' five-row synthetic fixture demonstrates delivery behavior and requires a representative evaluation before real use. No Terraform apply, customer deployment, or external model promotion was performed.

Terraform's strict enterprise Checkov checks remain enabled. The current lab blueprint still has findings involving organization-specific encryption/Google Groups settings and cluster policy/audit controls. Review these with the organization settings before deployment; no checks were weakened to produce a green result.

Image scanner findings were used to set minimum fixed packaging/runtime dependency versions. Scanner reports are retained as artifacts and uploaded with explicit reporting permission. Trivy's action commit was verified against the [official release](https://github.com/aquasecurity/trivy-action/releases/tag/v0.36.0).

Existing unrelated local edits were preserved in the eight identified projects; the local profile snapshot was also left untouched by the upgrade commit.
